topic: Compiler/execution feedback for model training; compilation environments and execution world models; efficient Lean compilation for RL feedback
questions: How is compiler / execution / verifier feedback used as a training signal for code and proof models (RL from execution, expert iteration, repair), and where does it fail?
How are compilation/execution environments built at scale for training (sandboxes, Lean interaction tools), and can learned world models of execution/compilation substitute for or augment them?
What makes Lean verification fast enough for RL feedback (REPL state reuse, environment pickling, incremental elaboration, parallel verifier servers), and what throughputs are reported?
inclusion: Papers/tools that use compiler, interpreter, test or proof-checker outcomes as training or search signal; that build execution/verification environments for ML; that model code execution with neural nets; that measure or improve Lean/ITP verification throughput
exclusion: Pure program synthesis without execution signal; formal verification unrelated to ML; natural-language-only RLHF
